prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
“Best” depends on what you want (spray vs. UV, budget, location, single event vs. regular maintenance). I can help narrow it down — a few quick questions:

- Do you want a spray (sunless) tan or UV/bed tanning?
- Which part of Columbus are you near (neighborhood or ZIP code)?
- Is price a major factor or is quality/longest-lasting/most natural look most important?
- Any event/date you need it for?

If you just want guidance now, here’s how to pick the best salon and what to look for:

What to prefer
- For safety and most natural results: choose a professional spray (airbrush) tan technician rather than UV beds.
- Look for salons with many recent 4–5 star reviews and lots of before/after photos.
- Clean facility, trained technicians, and single-use or well-sanitized spray nozzles/hoods matter.

Checklist when comparing salons
- Recent reviews mention “natural,” “no streaks,” “even fade,” and “lasted X days.”
- Photos of actual clients (not only stock photos).
- Technician experience and training — ask about product brand and solution customization (shade, undertone).
- Pricing transparency (patch test, session length, packages, add-ons).
- Pre- and post-care instructions and availability of complementary products (exfoliant, barrier cream).
- Cancellation and re-tan policies.

Safety note
- UV tanning increases skin cancer risk. If you use UV beds, ask about lamp age and maintenance. Consider sunless spray for safer results.

If you want, tell me your neighborhood or whether you want spray or UV and I’ll give a short list of top-rated options and what to ask each salon.
